stemMd: A cylinder has radius 3 centimeters and height 10 centimeters. What is its volume?
explanationMd: Cylinder volume is πr²h. Substitute r=3 and h=10 to get π(9)(10)=90π cubic centimeters. The squared radius gives the circular base area.

distractorRationale.a: This uses circumference times height rather than base area times height.
